title: Touka Totem
description: This resource pack replaces the totem model with the character Touka from Tokyo Ghoul.
body:
## ABOUT

This resource pack replaces the totem model with the character Touka from Tokyo Ghoul.

Also, when the totem is activated, it makes the sound "The mark will never fade even in death"

With this resource pack, you can truly become a real ghoul.I also wish you a pleasant game.
